decisions.reason: Custom earmolds for in-ear systems build directly on the firm's long-standing audiology materials and earmold manufacturing knowledge, so it can readily interpret early results and refine the product, though its mere mention on the website suggests slightly lower prominence.
The individual in-ear earmold has a dedicated page and is closely tied to the firm's core competence in otoplastics and hearing-system fitting, giving high absorptive capacity to improve it.
A vacuum thermoforming unit extends the firm's established thermoforming equipment line for dental and lab use, so existing engineering know-how and its customer base support further development.
